name: com.flightmapworld/flights
title: FlightMapWorld
description: Flight routes worldwide: nonstop destinations, airlines, flight times and the lowest fares.

tools.name: search_airports
tools.description: Finds airports by city, airport name, country or IATA code. Returns each airport with its three-letter IATA code, city, country and a link to the airport page with every destination served from it.

query.description: City, airport name, country or IATA code, for example "Bucharest", "Heathrow" or "OTP".

limit.description: How many airports to return (1 to 10, default 5).

tools.name: get_route
tools.description: Everything known about flying from one airport to another: whether a nonstop flight exists and which airlines fly it, flight time, distance, the cheapest dates with their fares, the lowest fare per month, and where fares with stops change planes. Fares come from cached searches; route_url is the route page and book_url a flight search for that date, where the live price is shown.

origin.description: IATA code of the departure airport, three letters, for example OTP or LHR.

destination.description: IATA code of the arrival airport, three letters, for example OTP or LHR.

month.description: Optional month to look at, as YYYY-MM. Without it the cheapest dates of the whole year ahead are returned.

tools.name: list_destinations
tools.description: Where you can fly from an airport, cheapest first: each destination with its lowest one-way fare, whether the flight is nonstop, the airline and the flight time. Answers questions like "where can I fly from Cluj for under 50 dollars" or "nonstop destinations from Lisbon".

origin.description: IATA code of the departure airport, three letters, for example OTP or LHR.

nonstop_only.description: Only destinations with a nonstop flight (default false).

max_price_usd.description: Only destinations with a one-way fare at or under this many US dollars.

country.description: Only destinations in this country, as a two-letter ISO code, for example ES or IT.

limit.description: How many destinations to return (1 to 50, default 20).

tools.name: find_connections
tools.description: Ways to get between two airports that have no convenient nonstop flight, built from nonstop legs seen in recent fare results: where to change planes, the airlines, flight time and lowest fare of each leg. The legs are separate tickets, with no guaranteed connection between them.

origin.description: IATA code of the departure airport, three letters, for example OTP or LHR.

destination.description: IATA code of the arrival airport, three letters, for example OTP or LHR.
